title: BSNL Senior Executive Trainee Answer Key 2026 – Out
vacancyDetails: About 120 Senior Executive Trainee posts (Telecom & Finance streams); provisional CBT answer key
qualification: Engineering / Finance professional degree as per BSNL SET notification stream-wise
applicationFee: As per BSNL online application fee
selectionProcess: Computer Based Test → Document Verification → Further stages as notified
documentsRequired: Admit card, registration credentials, photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://bsnl.examresponse.in or bsnl.co.in exam link
2. Login with roll number and password
3. Download response sheet and answer key
4. Raise objections till about 17 July 2026
5. Await final key and result
shortDescription: BSNL SET Answer Key 2026 out on 10 July for Senior Executive Trainee exam on 5 July 2026. Objection till ~17 July.
content:
Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited (BSNL) has released the Senior Executive Trainee (SET) Answer Key 2026 on 10 July 2026.

CBT exam: 5 July 2026 for Telecom & Finance streams. Objection window till about 17 July 2026.

Download response sheet from the official exam response portal linked on bsnl.co.in.
